node.title: Full-prefix to p-free syndrome reduction and full-cube route cut
node.statement: In characteristic p, every full depth-t elementary locator-prefix fiber on A-subsets is contained in one fixed-weight fiber of the p-free power-sum map Psi_J(S)=(sum_{x in S}x^j)_{1<=j<=t,p not dividing j}; hence it is also contained in a fiber of the same F_p-linear map on the full Boolean cube. At the official N=2^41 exact-list depth, however, t log2|B0|<=N-129. The full-cube map has at most |B0|^t outputs, so pigeonhole forces a fiber of size at least 2^(N-t log2|B0|)>=2^129>N^3=2^123. Therefore replacing the fixed Hamming slice by the unweighted Boolean cube cannot prove the N^3 maximum-prefix target; any F2/list-recovery bridge must retain the weight or an equally strong owner decomposition.
